categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes an HTTP server race condition where pipelining a keep-alive request followed by a 'Connection: close' request can cause the I/O thread to disconnect prematurely and drop the second response. While a legitimate correctness fix for pipelined HTTP requests, it addresses a narrow edge case that is reasonably deferrable without broader impact on RPC stability.
